summary: Wave 4 email + notification-preferences + checkout regression tested end-to-end (SAFE MODE, live prod DB). Backend pytest 4/4 pass: (1) POST /api/track/visitor {page:'/'} returns 200 {ok:true} (no-op retained), (2) POST /api/user/login with onarrival21@gmail.com returns 200 with accessToken (no 500 after removing known-device email branch in userShared.ts), (3) authenticated GET /api/user/profile returns 200, (4) round-trip: GET /api/notifications/preferences?company_id=1 -> PUT with categories.confirming=true -> GET confirms confirming===true persisted -> PUT restore to original false -> GET confirms restore (state clean; no other pref values touched). Static: `npx tsc --noEmit` = 0 errors. `node scripts/check-email-dark-mode.mjs` = OK (32 sources clean). Email render harness `audit_render_all_emails.ts` rendered 141/141 with no 'no-output'/'error:' lines. Grep of /app/plan/audit/emails/html: no un-interpolated `{{` handlebars, © 2026 Dynopay Payments Ltd. present in all 141 HTMLs, 12 DE-locale files miss the exact English footer string 'You're receiving this' because their footer is translated to German ('...erhalten...') — not a bug, spec check is EN-only. 5 files still contain the un-swapped %%TO_EMAIL%% token (018_activation_gate_brand, 019_activation_gate_wallet, 020_activation_gate_kyc, 102_payments_overpaid_merchant, 140_refund_merchantRefund_completed): these are written via `writeBuilt()` which bypasses `mailTransporter.sendEmail`'s token-swap; at actual send time the token IS replaced, so this is a harness-render artifact rather than a live-email defect, but flagging per spec strictness. Frontend: /auth/login 2-step login works (login-email-input -> Continue -> password-input -> signin-submit-btn -> /dashboard). /settings?section=notifications: company-categories-toggle click reveals company-category-confirming-switch (aria-checked absent -> UI toggle uses a checked class; visually OFF by default, screenshot captured; not toggled per instructions), title 'Confirmation progress' present, description contains 'Off by default'. /pay?d=rNtQRX renders clean-checkout-currency-select with all coin-cost hints (COIN-USDT verified), network chips clean-checkout-network-POLYGON + clean-checkout-network-TRC20 (as Tron), clean-checkout-network-cheapest badge on Polygon ('CHEAPEST'), clean-checkout-continue-hint contains 'network fee'. Continue button NOT clicked (would reserve live address).

minor.issue: 5 rendered HTML files contain un-swapped %%TO_EMAIL%% token (018/019/020 activation-gate, 102 payments_overpaid_merchant, 140 refund_merchantRefund_completed). These templates are captured via writeBuilt() which does not run the mailTransporter token-swap (which replaces %%TO_EMAIL%% with the recipient). In production the swap DOES happen at send-time so live emails are correct; this is a harness completeness gap. Consider making writeBuilt run the raw HTML through the same swap that mailTransporter does before writing, OR asserting in a follow-up test.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): in scripts/audit_render_all_emails.ts, replace %%TO_EMAIL%% with the recipient before fs.writeFileSync inside writeBuilt() so the spec check 'no file contains %%TO_EMAIL%%' passes without ambiguity (5 files affected: 018_activation_gate_brand, 019_activation_gate_wallet, 020_activation_gate_kyc, 102_payments_overpaid_merchant, 140_refund_merchantRefund_completed).

Optional: audit spec grep for footer why-line currently only accepts English 'You're receiving this' — 12 DE locale files use the German translation 'erhalten'. Either update the grep to accept the i18n variant or skip DE files. No functional defect.
